title: DANDERYD drop-leaf table
description: DANDERYD drop-leaf table, oak veneer/white, 291/8/523/4x311/2" This drop leaf table is perfect for a smaller kitchen or as an accent in a larger room. You can go three ways – no leaves, one leaf, or two. A traditional look with details like turned legs give it that little extra.
features: Matches well with DANDERYD, INGOLF, SKOGSTA, EBBALYCKE and BERGMUND chairs, sold separately.
May be completed with FIXA stick-on floor protectors to protect the underlying surface against wear.
materialAndCare: Underframe/ Supporting rail/ Leg: Steel, Epoxy/polyester powder coating; Inside leg: Steel; Table top/ Drop leaf: Particleboard, Oak veneer, Solid oak, Clear acrylic lacquer
